definition: Brave Leo is a large language model-based chatbot developed by Brave Software and built into the Brave browser.
details: Marketed as a privacy-preserving assistant, Leo can summarize and translate web pages, answer questions about page content, generate text and code, and hold conversational exchanges, all from the browser's address bar or sidebar.
story: Picture a translator at the United Nations, listening to one language and whispering the meaning into another in real time. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. It does not memorize a rulebook; it absorbs a library. Meaning lives in company — a word is known by the words it keeps. That pattern-earned fluency is Brave Leo.
